pull: Clue: Its nickname was all about its guns
photoNote: Early B-17D at Wright Field, about 1941. U.S. Air Force photo, public domain. Not the ditched aircraft (40-3089). Photo file not yet in the repo: the card was rendered in the browser and uploaded straight to Typefully.
photoCredit: An early B-17D Flying Fortress at Wright Field, Ohio, about 1941. U.S. Air Force, public domain.
body:
Can you name this aircraft?

On 21 October 1942, one of these got lost over the Pacific and ditched at sea. Eight men climbed into life rafts, including America's top fighter ace of the First World War. They drifted for more than three weeks.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
